newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Proton, Hicom say results on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Proton, Hicom say results on Friday.

text.p: Malaysian carmaker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) and its parent company Hicom Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday they would release their financial results on Friday, June 20, 1997.
The results for the year to March 31, 1997 are expected to be released at 5.30 p.m. local time (0930 GMT).

Analysts contacted by Reuters earlier this month predicted that Proton's net profit would be twice previous year's, based on increased production and a weaker Japanese yen against the ringgit during the period.

For the year to March 31, 1996 Proton's net profit stood at 354 million ringgit. A poll of 33 analysts by Edinburgh Financial Publishing's Estimates Directory covering the stock projected the company's net earnings to be 713 million ringgit in the year to March 31, 1997.
Hicom's profit is also expected to increase sharply.

The Estimates Directory polled 22 analysts who on an average predicted the net profit would increase to 571.8 million ringgit for the year to March 31, 1997 from 284.5 million ringgit in the year-ago period.
